packageRules.description: Patch and minor updates (npm, mise, GitHub Actions) merge by themselves once CI is green
Major updates in their own PRs, merged by themselves once CI is green (CI cannot see visual changes in rendered diagrams)

TypeScript and typescript-eslint minors and patches in a group of their own, so a TypeScript version typescript-eslint does not support yet (its peer range, enforced by npm) fails only this PR, not the shared non-major group. The PR turns green by itself once typescript-eslint supports the new version. matchPackageNames matches the npm package, so an alias such as "typescript": "npm:@typescript/native@…" is not included.
A TypeScript major waits for approval on the Dependency Dashboard: typescript-eslint supports TypeScript 7 only through the separate @typescript/native package.
